name: Demon, Scourge
body:
Demon, Scourge CR 7

XP 3,200
CE Medium outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; see in darkness, Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 18, flat-footed 16 (+7 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)
hp 79 (8d10+35)
Fort +11, Ref +13, Will +7
DR 5/good; Immune fire, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10; SR 16

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee longsword +14/+9 (1d8+6)

STATISTICS

Str 20; Dex 25; Con 21; Int 14; Wis 18; Cha 21
Base Atk +9; CMB +14; CMD 31
Feats Dodge, Flyby Attack, Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Diplomacy)
Skills Bluff +14, Diplomacy +18, Fly +17, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (planes) +8, Perception +16, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +16
Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic; telepathy 50 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

At will, dominate person (DC 16)

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Abyss)
Organization solitary, pair, or sisterhood (3–13)
Treasure double (+1 longsword)

The demonic scourge is an infiltrator, often sent by the Abyssal Lords to ensnare and corrupt mortals in order to pave the way for darker plans. These demons seek to play the role of a power behind the throne, guiding their corrupted charges to ever-worse choices and actions.

Before combat, a scourge will often attempt to parley (giving them time to use their dominate person ability), or preserve their own life and flee. That said, a scourge is a fierce foe, and is fully capable in combat.

A scourge is always female, stands 6 to 7 feet tall and weighs 160 pounds. They have a large pair of dark, feathered wings. While sometimes confused for an erinyes devil, the scourge is vastly different, but a Knowledge check would be required to tell the two types of outsiders apart.

Compendium Imaginarium. Copyright 2015, William Murakami-Brundage; Author: William Murakami-Brundage.
